title: We Play Doom With John Romero
summary: IGN plays through the first episode of the original Doom with its creator John Romero providing commentary. Romero shares stories, design secrets and behind-the-scenes details about the levels, including E1M1.
why: HN commenters point to it as a fantastic developer commentary on how Doom's first episode was made.

quote.text: in this fantastic developer commentary he did for the game's first episode with IGN
